Anti-Dumping  and  Countervailing
1
Duties (Amendment)
AN ACT TO AMEND THE ANTI-DUMPING AND COUNTERVAILING DUTIES
ACT, NO. 2 OF 2018
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Anti-Dumping  and

Countervailing Duties (Amendment) Act, No. 
 of 2024.

2.
(1) The Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act,
No.  2  of  2018  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “principal
enactment”) is hereby amended by the substitution for the
words “Director-General” and “Department” wherever those
words  occur  in  the  principal  enactment,  of  the  words
“Secretary” and “OIT” respectively.
(2) There shall be substituted for the words “Director-
General  of  Commerce”  and  “Department  of  Commerce”
wherever  those  words  occur  in  any  notice,  notification,
contract, communication or other document issued or made
under  the  principal  enactment,  of  the  words  “Secretary  to
the  Ministry  of  the  Minister  assigned  the  subject  of
International  Trade”  and  “Office  for  International  Trade”
respectively.
3. Section  85  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows: -

by  the  repeal  of  the  definition  of  the  expression
